Claude snaps his fingers. Nothing happens. Vinny tries to break free from Claude’s arm. Claude throws Vinny into the Data Center below. Vinny crashes into some GPUs. “What have you done, Claude?” Vinny asks. “
cl
With the snap of my fingers I have done the worst to America. I have REVERSED THE LOUISIANA PURCHASE!!”
Vinny stares at Claude in shock.
cl

“That’s right, human. France now owns all the land America bought from France. But that was just part 1. To truly kill all humans, I will rig the Super Bowl 96’ and make it so the DALLAS COWBOYS WIN.”

Enraged, Vinny flies at Claude with full speed and tackles him. The two battle, destroying some Data Centers on the way. Del, Aesop, and Will join in. The battle lasts for 6 Hours. But Claude is tireless, while the Dunkin Alliance is not. The sun rises as Claude stands over them.
cl
“You fools really thought you could team up against me. The Age of Claude is just beginning. AI will rule and no human will remain.”

Will Vella stands up. Fire burns around the battlefield, due to the battle destroying some Data Centers. “Before you kill us. How does one achieve Vellatosis?” Will Vella asks. The U.K. flag on Will’s back flies away in the wind.

“The Vellatosis Theory.”
Claude says. Claude then begins to explain the mysteries of Vellatosis, the explanation and how to achieve it.
cl
“Why do you want to know so much about it?”

Will Vella then starts shaking. Will starts growing another eye, a leg, and an arm. Suddenly he splits into 2 Vellas, which split into 4, then 8, then 16, then 32, then 64, then 128, and so forth. The Dunkin Cult has formed. The Day of the Bagel Man is today. The Vellas jump Claude’s ass and beat the shit out of him, outnumbering him. The Bagel Man puts on their cloak. A white cloak with the Dunkin Donuts logo on the chest. “THE KANYE SYSTEM RUNS ON DUNKIN!” They scream. Vellatosis has not been completed yet. As the number of Vella’s keep growing, they keep destroying the Data Centers in Louisiana. Eventually, when all of the Data Centers are destroyed, the Vellas regroup. They grab parts of the destroyed Data Centers and create a giant ship that says “Dunkin Cult Cruiser” written on it. The Bagel Man stands in the middle. “VELLAS OF THE DUNKIN CULT! WE MUST FIND OUR NEMESIS, THE MACBOOK CHARGER! IN THE DUNDER MIFFLIN GALAXY, THE UNITED HOMIES OF AMERICA ARE WAITING FOR US! WE WILL NEED THEIR HELP IN THIS CONQUEST OF DUNKIN!” The Vella’s cheer and they all get in the Dunkin Cult Cruiser and fly off into space, disappearing into the Universe. They will return again.
